<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative progress:</strong> Parliament successfully passed the Bankers’ Books Evidence Bill and a new law establishing a panel to select tribunal chiefs and members, despite ongoing disruptions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxPTmVDS3ZPQjlNdXNKMF9FOXpkdEk0Y09BLUxXa3k4UHFzZndIZDd4NWZST3FmQ250am83Yzczb0MzUm9SLUxhWG54QlAxbzNaazBESVo3ZFNna1F3NGotRkE1SzhkZHhCMm1NWm9tdmdMYzFFT2theVdSTzRSTmZ1WTBjcTVVSUJzZ0E?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>

</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election oversight:</strong> The Election Commission of India and State Election Commissioners concluded a National Round Table Conference in New Delhi to discuss electoral governance.</li>
  <li><strong>Infrastructure status:</strong> The Rajya Sabha clarified that the PRLIS project is currently not under consideration for national project status.</li>
</ul>
